Global (All).title: US-Iran Tensions Escalate Amid Ongoing Nuclear Deal Talks
Global (All).summary: US threatens Iran with military action over potential nuclear deal, while Iran demands guarantees on the deal's terms.

Global (All).title: North Korea Fires Ballistic Missiles
Global (All).summary: North Korea conducted a missile test, further escalating tensions with the international community.

Global (All).title: Russia-Ukraine Military Conflict Continues to Unfold
Global (All).summary: Fighting between Russian-backed forces and Ukrainian forces continues, sparking global concern.

United States.title: US Supreme Court blocks House from obtaining Trump documents
United States.summary: The US Supreme Court on Monday blocked a House panel's attempt to obtain President Donald Trump's tax returns and other financial records, dealing a setback to Democrats' efforts to investigate the former president's finances.

United States.title: Russia's Wagner Group allegedly involved in US prison riot
United States.summary: The US Department of Justice said on Friday that it is investigating possible foreign involvement in the violent riot at the US Correctional Institution in Hazelton, West Virginia, in which 19 inmates and two corrections officers were injured.

United States.title: US judge blocks Biden's plan to end Title 42
United States.summary: A US federal judge on Monday blocked the Biden administration's plan to end Title 42, a pandemic-era rule that has allowed the US to quickly expel migrants at the border, dealing a blow to the administration's immigration plans.

South Korea.summary: South Korea and the US conducted joint military drills in response to North Korea's missile launches.

South Korea.title: South Korean government announces stricter COVID-19 measures amid rising cases
South Korea.summary: The South Korean government has imposed stricter COVID-19 measures due to the rising number of cases.

South Korea.title: US, South Korea and Japan agree to enhance cooperation on North Korea and security issues
South Korea.summary: The US, South Korea and Japan have agreed to strengthen their cooperation on North Korea and security issues.
